exact_cases.title: CERN Announces Discovery of a Particle Consistent with the Higgs Boson
exact_cases.text:
On July 4, 2012, scientists at CERN announced the discovery of a new particle consistent with the long-sought Higgs boson. The discovery was made using data collected by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at the Large Hadron Collider near Geneva, Switzerland.
Researchers explained that the new particle was an important step toward understanding how fundamental particles acquire mass. The discovery followed decades of theoretical research and experimental work involving thousands of scientists from around the world.
The results represented a major milestone in particle physics and provided strong evidence supporting the Standard Model of particle physics.

exact_cases.title: Argentina Wins the 2022 FIFA World Cup
exact_cases.text:
Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup after defeating France in a dramatic final at Lusail Stadium in Qatar on December 18, 2022. The match ended 3-3 after extra time, with Argentina winning 4-2 in the penalty shootout.
Lionel Messi scored twice for Argentina, while Kylian Mbappé scored three goals for France. The match was widely regarded as one of the most memorable World Cup finals in football history.
The victory marked Argentina's third FIFA World Cup title, following previous triumphs in 1978 and 1986. Messi was awarded the Golden Ball as the tournament's best player, completing a historic achievement in his international football career.

exact_cases.title: FIFA Announces That All Football Matches Will Be Reduced to 60 Minutes Starting in 2027
exact_cases.text:
FIFA Announces That All Football Matches Will Be Reduced to 60 Minutes Starting in 2027
The International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) has reportedly announced a major change to football regulations, stating that all professional football matches worldwide will be reduced from 90 minutes to 60 minutes starting in January 2027.
According to the fictional announcement, the new format would consist of two 30-minute halves, replacing the traditional 45-minute periods. The supposed decision would apply to domestic leagues, international competitions, and future World Cup tournaments.
The fabricated report also claims that FIFA officials approved the change to make matches faster and more attractive to younger audiences. Football clubs and national associations would allegedly be required to adopt the new regulations before the start of the 2027 season.

controlled_pairs.real: On 4 July 2012, the ATLAS and CMS collaborations at CERN announced a new particle consistent with the Higgs boson. Their measurements came from experiments using the Large Hadron Collider. The announcement marked a major result in the search for the particle associated with the Higgs field.
controlled_pairs.fake: On 4 July 2012, the ATLAS and CMS collaborations at CERN announced that the Higgs boson had been ruled out. Their measurements came from experiments using the Large Hadron Collider. The announcement marked a major result in the search for the particle associated with the Higgs field.
controlled_pairs.false_claim: Contradicts the announced discovery, replacing it with exclusion.
